nav.title: Xiyimo xa nkhomelo wa AI
nav.subtitle: Matsalelo ya tindzimi to tala ni ku hundziseriwa eka munhu.

status.apiUnavailable: Ku nghena / API a yi kona

stats.providerQualificationNote: Tindzimi le ti ringetiweke ntsena ti hlayiwa

customer.title: Sungula mbulavulo
customer.consentText: Ndzi pfumela leswaku mbulavulo lowu wu nga hlengeletiwa hi muphakeli wa AI. Matsalwa ma hlayisiwa ma nga si hlayisiwa.
customer.setupHint: A swi koteki ku fikela loko mululamisi a lulamisa khii ni muphakeli.
customer.noConversation: A ku na mbulavulo lowu tirhaka
customer.startHint: Endla mbulavulo hi nsivelo ku sungula.
customer.chatEmpty: Marungula ma vonaka laha. Mintirho ya AI i swibumabumelo ntsena; a ku na hakelo kumbe ku cinca ka akhawunti.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Rivandla ra browser ri rhumeriwa eka muphakeli; OpsCore a yi vuli leswaku yi hlayisa rivandla.
customer.voiceRequirement: Rivandla ra browser ri laveka HTTPS, makrofoni, nsivelo, mudel wa Realtime ni khii. A hi ri vito.

queue.title: Xiphemu xo hundzisela
queue.description: Mbulavulo leyo khomisa kumbe leyi kombelaka munhu yi vonaka laha. Xiphemu i xikombelo, a hi mbulavulo.
queue.empty: A ku na ku hundzisela eka nhlangano leyi.
queue.replyStorageNote: Tihlamulo ta vanhu ti hlayisiwile ti vonaka eka mbulavulo.
queue.resolveNote: Ku hetisiwile hi mutirhi loyi a nyikiweke.

boundaries.title: Imipaka ya mintirho
boundaries.automateBody: Ku hlamula ro sungula hi tindzimi to tala, ku hlamusela, ku kambisisa khombo ni ku hlayisa matsalwa.
boundaries.humanTitle: Ku hundzisela eka munhu swi laveka
boundaries.humanBody: Ku kombela munhu, ku tshembha loko ku nga ri kona, khombo leyikulu, milawu leyi nga riki kona, xivutiso lexi nga hlamuriwangi, xikombelo xa xihundla.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: A swi koteki hi phakete leyi ntsena
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP, WhatsApp, imeyili, ri vandla, CRM ni ku tiyisisa tindzimi swi laveka muphakeli wa ntiyiso ni miringo.

handoffReasons.low_confidence: Ku tshembha loko ku nga ri kona

messages.qualificationNotice: A ku na ririmi leri pfumeleriweke ku fikela miringo ya matsalwa, ASR, TTS ni rivandla yi hetiwa.
messages.configOk: Ku lulamisa ku kona. Ku hlangana ni khwaliti ya ririmi swi laveka miringo ya ntiyiso.
messages.conversationCreated: Mbulavulo wo hlayiseka wu endliwile. Khwaliti ya ririmi a yi pfumeleriwangi.
messages.handoffQueued: Ku hundzisela eka munhu ku vekiwe eka xiphemu ({reason}). I xikombelo, a hi mbulavulo.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Nhlamulo ya AI a yi hetangi. A ku na ntirho lowu endliweke. U nga kombela munhu.
messages.apiUnavailable: API ya nkhomelo a yi kumekangi. Nghena eka OpsCore, kutani u pfuxeta tluka leri.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Ku hundzisela ku vekiwe eka xiphemu ({reason}). Xiphemu a xi kombisi leswaku mutirhi u kona.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Ku hundzisela ku vekiwe eka xiphemu. Mbulavulo wa AI wu yima; ri vandla a ri lulamisiwangi.
messages.voiceCredentialRequest: Ku kombela khii ya rivandla ya nkarhana…
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Muphakeli wa Realtime u kombisile xihoxo. Misa rivandla, kambisisa ku lulamisa, kutani u ringeta.
messages.voiceActive: Mbulavulo wa rivandla wu tirha. Kombela munhu nkarhi wun'we ni wun'we; leswi swi endla xiphemu, a hi ri vandla.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Nsivelo wu laveka mbulavulo wu nga si sungula.
errors.SERVER_RESPONSE_INVALID: Nhlamulo ya sevha a yi hlayekangi.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Muphakeli wa rivandla wa Realtime a wu kumekangi.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Browser leyi a yi seketeli rivandla ra Realtime.
